summary.text: Tom Kessler is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 96 who has served since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he faces Democrat Jessica Maldonado and Libertarian Josef Trotter in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Kessler was born in Wichita, Kansas, and his career experience includes owning and operating Tom's Wine & Spirits.
He assumed office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Stephanie Yeager.
